gssapi_hostname.description: Hostname used for GSSAPI (e.g., fully qualified domain name of the mail server). Must match the principal in the keytab.

gssapi_keytab.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file. Leave empty to use the system default (typically /etc/krb5.keytab).

log_path.description: Path to the main Dovecot log file where GSSAPI events will be recorded.

auth_userdb_user.description: User owning the auth-userdb Unix socket for authentication database access.

auth_userdb_group.description: Group owning the auth-userdb Unix socket.

gssapi_auth_module_path.description: Path to the GSSAPI authentication module (if not auto-loaded). Adjust for architecture or distribution (e.g., /usr/lib64/dovecot/authgssapi.so).

gssapi_trusted_networks.description: List of CIDR networks allowed to use GSSAPI authentication. If empty, all networks are allowed (not recommended for untrusted environments).

gssapi_services.description: Custom per-service configurations to override defaults (e.g., for IMAP, POP3, or LDA). Add only if needed.

items.description: Configuration for a specific Dovecot service

listen.description: Addresses or hostnames this service listens on

max_processes.description: Maximum number of concurrent processes for this service

gssapi_enabled.description: Enable GSSAPI for this specific service (override global setting)
